subject: Money
title: Deposit Insurance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Deposit Insurance.

hook.text: The FDIC insures $250,000 per depositor. Since 1933, no insured depositor has lost a penny.

buildup.text: FDR created the FDIC after 9,000 banks failed in the Great Depression. People kept money under mattresses.

discovery.text: Insurance stopped bank runs. If your money is guaranteed, why panic? The insurance prevents the crisis.

twist.text: But insurance creates moral hazard. Banks take bigger risks because the government covers depositor losses.

climax.text: Deposit insurance is a paradox: it prevents panics by guaranteeing safety, which encourages risky behavior.

punchline.text: The safety net makes the tightrope tempting.

quiz.question: How much does the FDIC insure per depositor?
